jobs.title: Working Student - LLM Inference Performance
jobs.description: About Tensordyne  AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! About the Role How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster? As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams. You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance. You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization. This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects. jobs.title: Senior Electronics Design Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer to play a pivotal role in bringing our groundbreaking EV products to market. As an NPI Engineer, you will be the central figure industrializing our developments together with our engineering team, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.  Beyond traditional hardware ramp-up, this role is critical in building the "digital thread" of our serial production. You will be responsible for ensuring that as we scale quantities, our data remains structured, traceable, and ready for deep analytical insight.  What is your Day to Day Mission: Electrical System Architecture, Design, and Validation of Electric Powertrains Define systems and component requirements in collaboration with the project management team Conducting full PCBA development cycle: Design, Coordinating Manufacturing Process, Bring up, Verification, and Validation of PCBs Collaboration with our firmware engineering team across all processes Schematic design for BMS and charger updates, including bug fixes Schematic design for a combined testing platform charger-battery Design of battery simulation testbench Final PCB implementation with supervision of BMS and charger Defining subsystem-level test plans Following test plans What you bring to the team: Ability to work from our offices in Munich, Germany Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related fields At least three years of experience in the field Strong interpersonal and communication skills Experience in PCB design is a must Hands-on experience in an electronic lab environment is a must Understanding of power electronics systems Understanding of embedded firmware infrastructure Experience with compliance testing and EMC A structured approach to work and project management experience Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal German language skills are welcome   Your Benefits:  Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.  Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.  Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.  Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget.  Mobility Benefit: With our mobility budget, we pay your “Germany Ticket” for work or personal use monthly.  Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.  Language Courses: German isn’t your mother tongue? We sponsor German courses for you to quickly learn and integrate even more.    Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Buchhalter (m/w/x)
jobs.description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Finanzbereichs suchen wir Dich als erfahrenen Senior Buchhalter (m/w/d) , der nicht nur fachlich sicher im Rechnungswesen ist, sondern auch mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mitarbeitet. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung in der operativen Buchhaltung und bringst Dein Know-how in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Abläufen ein. Perspektivisch ist vorgesehen, dass Du im nächsten Schritt die fachliche Verantwortung für unser dreiköpfiges Team im Rechnungswesen übernimmst und damit eine wichtige Schlüsselrolle in unserem Finanzbereich einnimmst. Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung nach HGB, insbesondere in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung Mitarbeit bei der termingerechten Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB Durchführung von Kontenabstimmungen sowie Klärung und Buchung von Sachverhalten im Hauptbuch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Auswertungen, Reports und betriebswirtschaftlichen Analysen für die Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche Mitwirkung bei der Liquiditätsplanung sowie Unterstützung im Zahlungsverkehr und Mahnwesen Sicherstellung einer ordnungsgemäßen Buchführung unter Einhaltung gesetzlicher, steuerlicher und interner Vorgaben Ansprechpartner für buchhalterische Fragestellungen innerhalb des Unternehmens sowie für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und externe Dienstleister Mitwirkung bei steuerlich relevanten Themen, insbesondere im Bereich Umsatzsteuer, in Abstimmung mit externen Beratern Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von buchhalterischen Prozessen, Richtlinien und internen Kontrollen Mitarbeit an Projekten im Finanzbereich, z. B. bei der Digitalisierung, ERP-Weiterentwicklung oder der Optimierung von Reporting-Strukturen Je nach Teamstruktur fachliche Unterstützung und Anleitung von Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Rechnungswesen Fachliche Anforderungen:  Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) oder abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen/Finanzen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, idealerweise in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen Sehr gute Kenntnisse im HGB sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise SAP R/3, sowie sehr gute MS-Excel-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit BI-Tools von Vorteil Gute Kenntnisse in umsatzsteuerlichen Fragestellungen; weitere steuerliche Kenntnisse von Vorteil Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude an der operativen Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Affinität zu Zahlen, Prozessen und Systemen Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil   Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a  Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.   The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will  lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks.  You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success.   The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content.   SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces. Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe. Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility. Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations. Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability. Lead sys tem-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance. Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation.   JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field. 5+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms. Very strong background in communication theory. Practical experience working with antenna systems  (design, integration, or performance evaluation). Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS). Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams. Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews. Fluent in English (German language skills a plus). Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance.   WHAT WE OFFER The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team. High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs. Competitive compensation and benefits package. A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. jobs.title: Senior RF Engineer
jobs.description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a Senior RF Hardware Engineer  to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.   At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems.     At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment.      The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.   SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES Design and develop RF, mixed-signal, and digital hardware for electronically steered antenna (AESA) communication systems. Support the adaptation of existing hardware designs for new customer platforms, operational environments, and regional requirements. Develop RF front-end, power distribution, control, and interface circuitry for phased-array communication terminals. Own the development of hardware modules and subsystems from requirements through schematic capture, layout, integration, verification, and production release. Develop hardware requirements, perform trade studies, and support subsystem architecture development. Perform detailed schematic design for complex RF, mixed-signal, and high-speed digital circuit boards. Support PCB layout activities in Altium Designer, including stack-up definition, component placement, routing reviews, and design-for-manufacturing considerations. Perform engineering analyses including worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, and reliability assessments. Develop and execute hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, and design verification activities. Support RF characterization, system integration, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations using laboratory test equipment. Define and execute environmental, qualification, and compliance testing activities, including EMI/EMC verification. Collaborate closely with all the relevant engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: <h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h2> <p>We are looking for someone who is curious about the domain: what the process is, where people struggle, what is worth solving and how and then solutionise what is worth building using technology.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is an opportunity to redefine the role of design for a world experiencing constant AI disruption. A world where human judgement, empathy, systems thinking, and creativity become the real differentiators, while AI accelerates the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).&nbsp;</p> <p>You will work closely with CXOs, product owners, engineers and data scientists to co-own the product vision and help them craft the path forward. Within the team, you will drive ambiguity towards real, valuable outcomes through design.</p> <p>You will own and shape the product direction, challenge weak assumptions and stay close to implementation. You will leverage your collective experience as a design practitioner in this entire journey for driving impact on the client side. You will craft ‘new ways of working‘ from a design perspective with the influx of AI.</p> <p>We are not looking for someone whose primary focus is making requirements turned into artefacts, make things look polished or pixel-perfect.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>The Expectation</strong></span></h3> <p>You're comfortable across the full design lifecycle, but you're exceptional at the parts that make it land: sharp problem framing, design that ships, and AI-accelerated craft.</p> <p><strong>Consulting with Delivery in mind:</strong> Challenging the ask and ideating intervention that matters, and seeing them through.</p> <ul> <li>Turn ambiguous client asks into well-framed problems, prioritised opportunities and practical delivery plans.</li> <li>Challenge assumptions, agreed scope and propose solutions constructively, using evidence and arguments to help clients choose the new scope&nbsp;</li> <li>Pitch, consult and negotiate design decisions for faster iterations and decisioning.&nbsp;</li> <li>Stay with the problem, be the custodian for the north-star&nbsp; throughout delivery.</li> <li>Constantly reframe design decisions as new constraints and evidence emerge.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Design that ships: </strong>Owning the work from framed problems to live product.</p> <ul> <li>Own design across the lifecycle: discovery, concept, design, build, launch and iteration.</li> <li>Create artefacts precise enough to build from, including flows, wireframes, prototypes.</li> <li>Design for production reality: complex workflows, edge cases, data and system constraints.</li> <li>Work inside the engineering cadence with technologists, data specialists and product owners, balancing user value, business impact, technical feasibility and delivery pace.</li> <li>Measure what changed after launch and iterate using product analytics, user conversations and iterate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-accelerated craft:</strong> Using AI to design better, and designing better AI native products</p> <ul> <li>Use AI across research, synthesis, ideation and prototyping to compress design cycles.</li> <li>Apply judgment to AI output: know when it's good enough, and when it isn't.</li> <li>Spot where AI and automation genuinely move user and business outcomes, and where they don't.</li> <li>Design AI-enabled experiences that handle model behaviour, uncertainty, failure states beyond screens from user experience perspective.</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.description: <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">A different kind of organisation</span></h3> <ul> <li>High trust, transparency, and autonomy</li> <li>Small teams, high ownership, flat structures</li> <li>Radical compensation transparency</li> <li>Sense of ownership in collective success</li> <li>Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">The role</span></h3> <p>As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting &amp; tech delivery role&nbsp; and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What the work looks like</span></h3> <p>We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:</p> <ul> <li>Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.</li> <li>Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.</li> <li>Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.</li> <li>Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.</li> </ul> <p>The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 18pt;">What you'll do</span></h3> <h4>Frame Problems &amp; Propose Solutions</h4> <ul> <li>Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.</li> <li>Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.</li> <li>Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.</li> </ul> <h4>Lead Through Technical Excellence</h4> <ul> <li>Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.</li> <li>Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.</li> <li>Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems&nbsp; and the practices that keep them that way.</li> </ul> <h4>Influence, Advise, and align</h4> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.</li> <li>Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams</li> <li>Converge competing priorities into a path forward.</li> <li>Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.</li> </ul> <h4>Operate Across Technology Domains</h4> <p>Distributed systems, data engineering, AI &amp; agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.</p>

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Developer Productivity
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p> <p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them.</p> <p>That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving, LLM-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work hybrid from our UK office in London. jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. jobs.title: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description: The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist supports new customers through the Didomi onboarding cycle, from Kick-Off to deployment and handover to the Customer Success team. The role is the entry point into the Customer Onboarding career path and is performed under the guidance of the Onboarding unit manager. The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist builds knowledge of the Didomi product suite and of customer privacy needs, keeps customer data up to date in Planhat, and relays customer feedback to the relevant internal teams. Key Activities :  Manage a defined portfolio of new customers of lower complexity (Growth Business), with a volume adapted to the learning curve.  Run the onboarding steps with support: Pre-Kick-Off, Kick-Off, setup and follow-up calls, Go-live monitoring, Platform Demo / QA, and closure Deliver standard product training sessions and share FAQs and Help Center content so that customers become autonomous Handle first-level implementation issues during the Onboarding phase and is an intermediate to the Support team. Flag onboarding risks (ghost customers, blocked projects) and apply the standard reminder and escalation rules Keep Planhat up to date in real time (owner, onboarding stage, date, tier, health, ghosting flag) Gather customer context from the Account Executive before Kick-Off and prepare the handover documentation for the CSM or KAM Collect customer feedback and log it for the Onboarding unit Contribute, with support, to a transverse initiative (documentation, training content, FAQs) Autonomy and Decision-making :  Works under supervision and within defined onboarding playbooks and internal rules Follows the standard onboarding process and prioritizes daily actions with guidance Escalates technical complexity, blocked projects, and ghost-customer risks to the Onboarding unit manager,Product team or the Support team.  Validates any workaround, exception, or on-hold decision with the Onboarding unit manager.  Working Relationships : Internal: Onboarding unit, Sales, Pre-Sales, CSM, Support, Product, Finance.  External: Customers (platform users and operational contacts), agencies, partners.  Required Skills and Competencies :  Customer service mindset: empathy, teaching ability, and capacity to simplify Basic understanding of SaaS products and web technologies Ability to organize and prioritize several customer projects in parallel, with guidance Rigor in updating CRM tools such as Planhat Curiosity for product and privacy topics Good verbal and written communication skills, and comfort with presenting in kick-off calls and training sessions Full professional proficiency in English Recruitment Process :   HR Screen (15 minutes) Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes) Case Study Presentation (1h) Founder Interview Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Financial Risk Advisory - Director

jobs.description: Does contributing to the smooth operations of a leading EU Agency appeal to you? Then this could be your next opportunity! About the Agency Our client, eu-LISA, is the European Union Agency responsible for operating large-scale IT systems that help keep Europe safe and support cooperation in areas like security, migration, and justice. Civitta, in cooperation with Talenta, provides temporary agency workers to eu-LISA. We are looking for OT Security Engineer (Physical Security Systems) supporting the Protective Security Sector within the Security Unit. The position is based in Strasbourg, France. About the Job In this role, you will protect the network and infrastructure behind the Agency’s physical security systems, such as access control, CCTV, intrusion detection and security management platforms. You will be a hands-on technical practitioner who assesses, hardens and improves this environment, working closely with the Physical Security Systems Administrators, ICT colleagues and external service providers. You will Carry out regular security assessments of servers, workstations, network devices and administration interfaces supporting physical security systems Identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, excessive privileges and possible attack vectors Maintain vulnerability registers, track remediation and verify that corrective actions are effective Implement corrective measures directly or coordinate them with technical stakeholders, and escalate unresolved risks Develop and maintain security baselines and hardening standards, and check compliance with them Support secure authentication, privileged access management and secure administration practices Assess LAN, VLAN and network segmentation, and the security impact of integrations and third-party connections Recommend and implement improvements to network segregation, access restrictions and resilience Contribute security expertise to infrastructure upgrades and the deployment of new security capabilities Produce technical reports and regular reporting on the security posture of the physical security infrastructure Monitor security advisories and threat developments, and contribute to the continuous improvement of security standards Requirements A university degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Systems or a related field Minimum 5 years of professional experience in network security, infrastructure security, cybersecurity or technical security assessment Proven hands-on experience in performing security assessments, analysing network jobs.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.  Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.  The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.       About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging . We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role . You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios , support atypical and beta deployments , and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities. What you will do Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments Apply hotfixes when appropriate Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact What we're looking for Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field 2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar) Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems Proficiency in Linux systems Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments) Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business Driver’s license B category Beneficial Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles Field testing experience Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc. Experience in motion planning or control Experience in robotic competitions Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction. Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characterist

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run product

jobs.description: About Deepdesk Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside. At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks. You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets. We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go. We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving. What You’ll Be Doing •  Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work. •  Keep our databases fast and reliable. •  Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. •  Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go. •  Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required. •  Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics. •  Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code. •  Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering. •  Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed. Our Stack •  Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go. •  Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API. •  Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch. •  Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build. •  Front end: TypeScript and React. •  Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape. What We’re Looking For •  Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus. •  Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL. •  Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus. •  Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength. •  A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery. •  Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment. •  Interest in voice and real-time system

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: About Us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production. The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI. You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster. What you’ll do: Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage What you’ll bring: 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them. Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake) Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs. This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. The role As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers. What you will do Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses. Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition. Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer. Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition. Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface. Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery. Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer. Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool. Your profile MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field. ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation. Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux. Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ). Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware. Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks. Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet. Experience with Git and collaborative code review. Full professional proficiency in English. We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you. Bonus Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition. Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering. High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development. Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data. Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment. Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team. What we offer Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product. Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven. A competitive salary for the Dutch market. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Account Executive - Danish Speaker
jobs.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses. We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones. But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you! What will you be doing? Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market; Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle); Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer; Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs; Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce; Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process; Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features. Dan is deze kans bij Schuberg Philis iets voor jou! jobs.title: Manager CTO Office
jobs.description: Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein. Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties. Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie. Sturing en beheersing Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten. Verandering en verbetering Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur; Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie; Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office; Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology; Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties; Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst; Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten; Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuu

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it? AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. jobs.title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description: SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt. Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. jobs.description: Wil jij impact maken aan de voorkant van onze uitdagende bouwprojecten? Heb je ruime technische kennis. Heb jij affiniteit met planning en prijsvorming? Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving.   Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer  maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten. Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen. Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! jobs.title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
jobs.description: Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing. Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE. Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen. We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt. YOU Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau; Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels; Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn; Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief; Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen; Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt). OUR OFFER Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie; Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever; Een inspirerende werkomgeving; Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent; De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen; De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers; Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback; Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand; Personeelskorting op de volledige KEUNE-collectie. KEUNE We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter. jobs.title: (Senior) Manager People & Organisational Transformation
jobs.description: Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness? At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organizational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters. What will you do? Your primary focus lies in the organizational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective orgnisational design take a center stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain. A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree with a numerical component. At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy. At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models. Affinity with the translation of strategic goals into resulting implications for employees. Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders. Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills. Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships. Fluent in Dutch and English. Your responsibilities will include: Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimization of processes to designing and implementing new business models. Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organizational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best. Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management. Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development. Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present. Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the Business Change Capability, and primary Organisational Transformation. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus of up to 4 months’ salary (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. What do you bring to the table? A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree with a numerical component.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues — they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows. Why this role is exciting High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders. Experimentation & Analysis: Drive hypotheses, prototype rapidly, and evaluate A/B test results objectively — scaling successful experiments and sunsetting features that miss target performance. Advanced Figma & Design System expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building, scaling, and architecting multi-platform design systems at the token and component level. jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description: As a Content Marketing Manager you will own organic social as an always-on channel for the Scandinavian market, translating the global content and brand strategy into relevant local content. You will manage the local community in their own language and act as the fast, native-speaking point of contact for market-specific content needs, working within existing SEO and brand frameworks rather than building a parallel strategy. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, such as pergolas and garden furniture, directly to customers. We are a premium e-commerce company with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, combining Nordic design with a clear focus on quality and customer experience. What You'll Do Turn the global content calendar and brand pillars into a market-specific plan aligned to local seasonality, holidays, and campaigns, and spot content gaps and opportunities. Own the daily organic social channels (Instagram, TikTok, and others): content creation, planning, and community management, adapting global assets to local tone and interacting with the community in the local language. Localise and adapt blog and on-site content from the global calendar, including cultural adaptation and light on-page SEO, and support blog refreshes. Act as the local-language quality check across all content types and the first point of contact for ad-hoc content needs, escalating to global Creative Ops when full production is required. Shape the influencer content plan, create briefings and timelines, track performance, and grow influencer outreach in the market, including repurposing creator/UGC content with credit and cleared rights. What You'll Bring 2–4 years in content marketing, organic social, or a hybrid content/social role, ideally in e-commerce or DTC. Native or near-native skills in a Scandinavian language, plus confident English for cross-team collaboration. Experience working within others' brand and SEO frameworks rather than setting strategy independently. Strong sense for short-form, social-first content plus solid long-form writing and editing, proven localisation experience (real adaptation, not just translation), and photo/video editing for fast social content. Nice to have: experience working with a central/global marketing function and familiarity with GA and native platform insights (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) for simple performance reporting. 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension · Fully paid, capped overtime without endless unpaid crunch 🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership of organic social and local content from day one and can grow into a senior role as influencer outreach expands and PERGOLUX scales further. ⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week of remote workation per year in the EU/UK 🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle Jobrad / bike leasing program for sustainable, healthy commuting Team culture with regular events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work meetups) and retreats Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows) Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products 📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin How to Apply Sounds like you? We'd love to receive your application. Find out more about us and open roles on our Career Page and on LinkedIn . PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Lead Plant Robotics Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Lead Plant Robotics Engineer to develop the manufacturing solutions that allow us to mass-produce solid rocket motors. As the lead, you will own the robotic handling strategy for our pilot plant, from the first layout concept through commissioning and scale-up, and you will lead the robotics team. This is a unique opportunity to define how rockets are built at scale. The pilot plant is the blueprint for the production lines that follow, and the robotic cells you lead will handle containers, motor casings and energetic materials every day. About us We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Own the robotics architecture of the pilot plant: robot selection, cell layouts, end-effectors, and handling concepts for buckets, transport boxes, motor casings and carriers. Lead the development of robotic handling solutions for dosing, mixing, casting, curing and demolding stations, including the explosion-protection concept (enclosure, pressure-resistant encapsulation or ATEX-certified equipment). Define robotics requirements for the full line and manage the interfaces with automation, process engineering, ERP/MES and external integrators. Lead the robotics engineering team and external suppliers, including specification, tendering, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT). Drive cycle-time, throughput and availability targets using offline programming, simulation and data from the pilot line. Lead the risk assessment and safety concept for robotic cells together with safety engineering (Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, ISO 13849). What we are looking for Significant professional experience (typically 3+ years) designing and commissioning industrial robotic systems, ideally in manufacturing or process environments. Lead-level experience: you have led technical teams or acted as technical authority on a robotic project from concept to production. Strong knowledge of industrial robot platforms (ideally ABB, Fanuc), including programming, offline programming and simulation. Solid understanding of machine safety (Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, ISO 10218, ISO 13849) and of structured risk assessment. A hands-on engineering mindset: you can move from a concept sketch to a CAD layout, and you can debug a cell on the shop floor. The ability to work with autonomy and at pace, and to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant. Desirable experience Robotic handling in explosion-protected or hazardous environments (Directive 2014/34/EU, TRGS 720 ff.), or with powders, pastes or chemicals. Vision systems, force-torque sensing, or automated quality checks (X-ray or CT integration). Multi-robot coordination, gantry systems, or AGV integration at production scale. Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and PLC integration. Experience building production capability from zero in a start
