jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: The Role Procurement and supply chain is a $3 trillion market still running on outdated systems and manual processes. Magentic is changing that. We’re building a new generation of agentic AI that works inside the world’s largest and most complex organisations, backed by Sequoia and built by a team from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We’re early, moving fast and already solving real problems for global enterprises. As a Deployment Strategist , you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale. What You’ll Do You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests. Own deployments end-to-end —design the rollout strategy at household-name enterprises, run the programme, and change course decisively when the approach isn't landing. Hold the senior relationships —be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations. Find the value nobody has scoped —go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next. Define best practice for AI deployment —set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale. Shape our roadmap —bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build. You Might Be a Great Fit if You Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information Communicate exceptionally well, both in the room with a VP and in a written handover to a colleague Bonus Points Have experience deploying AI, automation, or data products inside large organisations Are familiar with procurement, supply chain, or finance functions in enterprise settings Compensation and Benefits At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer: Competitive Equity : play a real part in Magentic’s upside A salary of £100-110k Enhanced parental leave 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown In-office lunches provided Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes Hybrid London HQ (4 days per week onsite, with flex if you have appointments etc) Annual team retreat —a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build Our Interview Process We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet. Initial call (30 mins) : this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team. Equal

jobs.title: Trust Communications
jobs.description: TL;DR Millions of people build on Lovable, from software that runs new businesses to the tools that power existing ones. At the center of it all is trust. That’s why we’re looking for an exceptional storyteller to spearhead Lovable’s trust, safety, and security communications efforts. Why Lovable For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now. Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too. The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway. What you’ll do Build and own Lovable’s trust narrative. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned, new, and owned media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, and safety. You’ll shape the stories that highlight our commitments and ensure we show up in the conversations where trust in AI platforms is being decided right now. Be the comms partner to our security and trust leadership. You’ll develop and own the spokesperson platforms for our CISO and other senior leaders who speak on our trust efforts, identifying and preparing them for on-stage and media opportunities. You’ll help them become recognized voices on topics of trust in AI software creation. Own incident communications, end to end. When something doesn’t go as planned, you’re the incident comms lead who ensures clear and swift communications for every audience that needs to hear from us, including media, customers, and employees. You’ll build and run the playbook that lets us move faster each time. Build relationships with relevant media and creators. You’ll know the voices who matter most in telling our trust story, and you’ll make sure those relationships exist before we need them. Who you are You’ve done trust, safety, or security communications. You have proven comms experience across a variety of trust-related topics, from AI safety to security. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams. You have real incident experience. You’ve been the incident comms lead more than once, and you’ve probably written a playbook along the way. You bring the attention to detail, precision, speed, and judgment an incident requires. You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. Security and trust reporters, analysts, policy-adjacent media, perhaps even researchers. You know who they are, what they care about, and how to earn their attention honestly. You’re voraciously curious. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type. More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits. About the role We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next. What we're looking for Campaign-oriented: Build campaigns around a real customer need, connecting audience, message and channels. High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video. Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign. Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social. Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel. Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round. Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful. AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters. Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale. Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change. Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site Experience 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through. Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus. Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful. Why Benetics AI A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan. Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work. Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns. Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work. How we hire Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call A practical case with the team. Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why. You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Senior Manager, Commercial Sales, you will lead and inspire a team of Commercial Sales Representatives covering diverse markets and segments across Southern EMEA, driving results through hands-on coaching, strategic pipeline management, and a relentless focus on exceeding targets. You will combine deep commercial expertise with a passion for developing people, building the programs, partnerships, and team culture needed to sustain high performance in a fast-moving, competitive cybersecurity market. If you are a creative self-starter who thrives on both leading from the front and investing in the success of those around you, this role is for you.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Lead, expand, and coach a team of Commercial Sales Representatives covering multiple Southern EMEA markets and segments — providing the resources, training, and day-to-day guidance needed to consistently achieve and exceed targets, including active call shadowing and ad hoc feedback sessions.</li> <li>Execute and supervise end-to-end sales activities including prospecting, lead follow-up, opportunity qualification, proof of concept management, commercial negotiation, and deal closure, while proactively managing the team’s funnel to ensure both quantity and quality of opportunities are on track for quota attainment.</li> <li>Conduct and execute quarterly business plans, create and develop new programs and campaigns in conjunction with Marketing and Sales, and design incentive plans and SPIFFs that foster a competitive, collaborative, and high-energy team environment — operating with confidence and limited guidance.</li> <li>Set accurate business expectations and maintain clear communication with senior sales management, measuring and reporting against KPIs and creating ad hoc reports as needed, while maintaining a thorough working knowledge of SentinelOne’s full product capabilities.</li>

jobs.title: Stage Operations & Events | Amsterdam Light Festival | Amsterdam mbo/hbo/wo
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Als Operations & Events Stagiair(e) help je mee om onze dagelijkse vaarten soepel te laten verlopen. Je ondersteunt het Operations-team op kantoor en op de kade, met een focus op het Amsterdam Light Festival. Dit is een van de drukste periodes van het jaar. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld bij de planning, coördineert vertrekkende boten en begeleidt gasten bij het instappen. Zo zorg je er samen met je collega's voor dat alles goed verloopt en gasten een fijne ervaring hebben. Je stage is afwisselend, met een combinatie van organiseren en praktisch aanpakken. Wat ga je leren? Helpen bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van het Amsterdam Light Festival; Ondersteunen bij de planning, roosters en administratie; Gasten ontvangen, instappen begeleiden en wachtrijen op de kade coördineren; Contact onderhouden met planners, duty managers, hosts, schippers en havenpartners; Checklists en registraties bijhouden en operationele gegevens verwerken; Meewerken aan projecten en verbeteringen binnen Operations. Praktisch Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk; Duur: 3 tot 6 maanden; Type stage: meewerkstage; Werktijden: Een combinatie van kantoortijden en operationele diensten. Beschikbaarheid in avonden en weekenden is vereist; Stagevergoeding: € 500 per maand; Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en de kade. Wat we aanbieden Een afwisselende meewerkstage waarin je zowel organisatorische als praktische ervaring opdoet; De kans om mee te werken aan de vaarten van het Amsterdam Light Festival en een uniek kijkje achter de schermen te krijgen bij een van de grootste rondvaartoperaties van Amsterdam; Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal; Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten; Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding. Functievereisten Een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in operations, events, hospitality, toerisme of bedrijfskunde; Een betrouwbare, praktische en gastgerichte instelling; Het vermogen om rustig te blijven bij drukte en flexibel omgaan met wisselende taken; Goede beheersing van het Engels, kennis van het Nederlands is een pre; Beschikbaar tijdens het Amsterdam Light Festival (ALF), ook in de avonden en weekenden; Kennis van Excel is een plus. Over Flagship Amsterdam Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is. Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. jobs.title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
jobs.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) . Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie. Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken. Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie. Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie. Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken. Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan. Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen. Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's). Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming. Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen. Wat vragen wij? Eisen Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid. Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerkers. Aantoonbare ervaring met functionele aansturing van privacyfunctionarissen of privacyadviseurs. Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen of doorontwikkelen van privacy governance en privacybeleid. Aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van hoger management over privacyvraagstukken. Pré Relevante privacycertificering, zoals CIPP/E of CIPM. Ervaring met het uitvoeren of beoordelen van DPIA's. Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie. Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken. Ervaring met Privacy by Design binnen organisatieprocessen of digitale producten. Kennis van en/of ervaring met de EU AI Act en de relatie tussen AI-governance en privacy. jobs.title: Senior AWS Consultant

We geloven in doen wat werkt: geen dikke rapporten, maar concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group About the role. We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant. When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers. How you embrace curiosity daily. Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities. Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues. Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes. Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability. Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams. Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs. How you make your mark. Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant. Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance. Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity. Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements. Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards. What you bring to the team. Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment. Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis. Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures. Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria. Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects. Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards. What sets you apart. Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings. Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering. jobs.title: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties
jobs.description: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking. Wat we je bieden Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover: Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw kennis, ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden; Een afwisselende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Veel zelfstandigheid en vrijheid om jouw werkzaamheden te organiseren; Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden; Afwisselende projecten binnen de utiliteitsbouw en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek; Opleidingen, cursussen en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen; Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren; Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's en korte communicatielijnen; De voordelen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van de VDK Groep, gecombineerd met de persoonlijke sfeer van Campus. Wat je gaat doen Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici; Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten; Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten; Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers; Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn; Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling; Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen; Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen. Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd. Wat neem je mee? Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider; Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling; Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren; Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling; Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen. jobs.description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify ’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. We explore, define, build, validate, and optimize new ideas to help listeners discover the content they love. Our work spans personalized Search, music video discovery and ranking, audiobook Search expansion, and the foundations of more social Search experiences. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artist and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos and Clips enable artists and their teams to grow, monetize and connect with their audience. We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode, part of the Music Mission. Discovery Mode helps artists and music marketers reach new listeners when it matters most. Artists and labels flag priority songs, and our system feeds that signal into the algorithms behind personalized playlists. In this role, you'll partner with product, engineering, and user research to build the technology that powers Discovery Mode. Your focus will be customer engagement and reporting — understanding what customers need, building instrumentation and dashboards for our self-serve product, and running experiments that improve the experience and drive business impact. As part of the Product Insights team, you'll help define the next generation of promotion products for the music industry. jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist / ML Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a product-minded applied data scientist or engineer to turn raw operational data into products that measurably improve how our customers make decisions and run their businesses. Which label you carry matters less to us than whether customers end up better off. This is not a research-only role, nor a service-oriented internal analytics position—and it is not a role for a model builder alone. We want an owner: someone who frames the problem, learns the domain, builds the data when it doesn't exist, ships the model, and stays with it until customers are acting on it and can measure the reward. The road runs through data engineering; deployment and testing are part of delivery, not a handoff. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, and measurable inside a real product. Whether you came to this work through statistics, software, analytics, or data engineering, you have a strong bias toward shipping. What You'll Do From Raw Data to Better Decisions Own the Outcome: Take an ambiguous customer problem, decide whether ML is even the right answer, build it, and stay with it until customers are acting on it. Learn the Domain: Get fluent in the semantics of how our customers operate—what a route, a crew, or a service history actually means. A model that is accurate but wrong about the domain creates nothing. Build the Data You Need: When the features don't exist, create them in Snowflake and dbt rather than waiting for someone else to. Prove It and Make It Felt Make the Value Legible: Decide how a prediction reaches the customer so they understand it, trust it, and act on it—then report realised impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up. Measure Honestly: Define offline and online evaluation for model quality, drift, and reliability, and design the A/B tests or causal analyses that prove a feature improved customer outcomes. Deliver Ship and Operate: Deployment, testing, versioning, monitoring, and drift detection. Delivery is part of the job, not a handoff. Embed with Product: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to put ML inside real product workflows—and say clearly when ML isn't the answer. Who We Are The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions, not by whether the model shipped. Closer to the Data and the Customer: You'd rather spend a week understanding what the data means than a week tuning a model. You know the domain is the hard part. A Multi-Disciplinary Operator: You'll chase down the data yourself when it isn't ready, and build the pipeline if that's what delivery requires. You prioritise usability, "Time to Insight," and customer trust as much as you do code efficiency. We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you have shipped a model you are proud of, we want to hear from you! HOW WE WORK We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next model faster to ship. The leverage is in the verification: the backtests, eval scaffolding, and data checks that make generated work safe to trust. What You'll Bring Experience: 5+ years in applied data science, ML engineering, or data engineering that included owning models in production—including at least one model you built and shipped into a real product. B2B SaaS experience is a strong plus. Technical Core: Strong Python and applied ML libraries for tabular problems (scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, statsmodels or Prophet). Solid SQL expertise is required. ML & Modeling Depth: Depth in supervised learning, forecasting, ranking, recommendation, or optimisation. You have modelled messy operational data, not benchmark datasets. Data & Delivery: You build the data you need and ship what you build—dbt and Snowflake modelling, feature pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and drift detection. We're on AWS.

jobs.title: GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM)
jobs.description: About the Job: AI-powered workflows are only as good as the customer data underneath them. LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As our GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM), you will set the rules that make our core customer data (accounts, contacts, subscriptions, and users) accurate, consistent, and trusted across Salesforce, our billing and finance systems, marketing automation, product usage data, and the data warehouse. This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of the data model and its standards. You will partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, Finance Systems, Legal, and Security to put those standards into production. Your work is the foundation for reliable reporting, accurate territory and segmentation, clean pipeline attribution, and the AI workflows that depend on high-quality data. Responsibilities: Own the MDM roadmap and operating model for the account, contact, and organization hierarchy domains. Define golden record rules: matching, merging, survivorship, and parent/child hierarchies across CRM, billing, product, and support systems. Set data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship roles, definitions, and quality SLAs, in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Run the processes for onboarding new data sources, handling change requests, and managing lifecycle events such as mergers, acquisitions, and customer reorganizations. Design and monitor data quality rules, scorecards, and dashboards covering completeness, accuracy, duplication, and timeliness. Drive remediation and report data health, risks, and progress to leadership with clear metrics and business impact. Specify integration patterns and acceptance criteria across Salesforce, the data warehouse, and enrichment providers, and work with Data Engineering and GTM Systems to build them. Recommend build vs. buy for MDM, identity resolution, enrichment, and data quality tooling. Provide trusted, well-documented data products for analytics and AI use cases. Act as the data owner with Legal and Security on PII handling, GDPR and CCPA requirements, retention, and access controls. Who You'll Work With: Data Engineering and GTM Systems build pipelines and Salesforce configuration. Legal and Security own privacy and security decisions, and you inform them as the data owner. You own the rules, standards, and acceptance criteria that tell everyone else what "correct" looks like. Qualifications: 8+ years of experience in data management, data governance, data engineering, or analytics, including 2+ years leading MDM or data quality programs. Hands-on experience designing match, merge, and survivorship rules and golden record or hierarchy models, with results you can describe. Experience with Salesforce data models and CRM data quality at scale. Experience building and operating a data governance framework: policies, stewardship models, and SLAs. Ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. A track record of delivering cross-functional programs without direct authority. Nice to Have Experience at a B2B SaaS company with a product-led or hybrid sales motion, including mapping product users and workspaces to CRM accounts. Familiarity with enrichment and firmographic data, entity matching approaches, and ML-assisted or LLM-assisted matching and cleansing. Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and security frameworks such as SOC 2. jobs.description: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need? Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. jobs.description: About this Role Hi, I’m Kevin . I manage the Data team and our analytics products at Ashby . I’m hiring our first Data Analytics Manager at an important point in Ashby’s growth, and I hope you have the patience to read a job posting that may be a little unconventional. You will manage Ashby’s three Data Analysts: two core analysts and one analyst focused on Revenue Operations. Our Data Engineer will initially continue to report directly to me, so this role is deliberately more focused on the analytical side of the team while remaining a close partner in the broader data ecosystem. The primary result of your successful management will be a team of analysts with excellent judgment, strong technical methods, clear communication, and a deep sense of ownership. I am looking for someone who can help that team do better work, choose better work, and grow into the next stage of Ashby alongside the company. Rather than begin with a long list of tools or years of experience, I want to share four questions that sit at the center of this role. If you apply, your answer should be “yes” to each. Should we get a chance to talk, what I will really want to understand is the nuance: your unique how, why, and what behind your answers. Can you identify and hire talented people? We will continue to grow the analyst team, and you will play a meaningful role in finding and assessing future teammates. Great analysts combine technical judgment, curiosity, communication, business context, and a willingness to own work end to end. Can you recognize that combination in others? Can you develop and amplify the data practices that let a small team do excellent work? Ashby’s Data team is lean, and our practices will need to evolve as the company becomes more complex. I see this role as an opportunity to improve the ways we prioritize work, review it, share knowledge, maintain quality, and collaborate. Can you lead the team through the transition from broad shared context to meaningful specialization? Today, each analyst can know a great deal about the company and data stack. That will become more challenging as Ashby grows across products, regions, systems, and business functions. We will need to develop stronger domain context and clearer ways of working without turning the team into a set of narrow, disconnected specialists. Can you help the Data team navigate the rapidly evolving implications of AI? AI will affect how our analysts work, how the company self-serves analytical questions, and how other teams use internal business data. Much of that work depends on trusted, well-modeled, appropriately accessible warehouse-derived data. You will help the Data team explore and evaluate the relevant tools, workflows, and partnerships—bringing ambition, practicality, and a high bar for accuracy. These questions add up to a simple reality: Ashby is growing quickly, and the surrounding data needs are becoming more complex. We are becoming a multi-product, global company with more business systems and larger team dynamics. This is a great opportunity at a great company, but it will be hard and consequential work. I am looking for a manager who is excited to help shape the Data function and build an excellent team for its current and future members. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Role Reporting to the Head of Decision Intelligence , you are the founding engineer of the Data Intelligence team. While the Head of Data sets the strategic "Brain" of the company, you build the nervous system. You are not building legacy dashboards; instead you are building the API-based tools, dbt models, and semantic layers that allow AI agents to navigate our data environment autonomously. The "Unlock Audio Intelligence" Project: Partner with the Head of Data to ingest thousands of hours of internal calls using Deepgram’s own models, turning unstructured audio into queryable insights for GTM teams. Automation Obsession: Maintain a culture where manual, repetitive SQL tasks are viewed as automation bugs to be solved with code and agents. AI-Native Technical Skills: Mastery of SQL and Python (production-grade) with a proven track record of building RAG or Agentic systems on top of structured data. Usage-Based SaaS Fluency: Familiarity with the metrics of an API-first business, such as consumption patterns, gross margins, and NRR. jobs.description: At H1 , we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us. The Data & Research team is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of H1's data — from source acquisition and onboarding through normalization, entity resolution, and product delivery. Working closely with Engineering, Product, and client-facing teams, this group ensures that every data source H1 adds is evaluated rigorously, integrated accurately, and delivered in a way that creates real value for the healthcare and life sciences organizations that rely on our platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1 As a Principal Analyst, Data Integration, you will own the end-to-end process of evaluating, scoping, and onboarding new data sources into H1's platform. This is a senior IC role at the intersection of data, engineering, and product — the connective tissue between raw data acquisition and what ultimately ships to clients. You will work across Data & Research, Engineering, and Product to define what a new source is, how it maps to H1's schemas, what it can realistically deliver, and what it can't. You will also work directly with client-facing teams to gather requirements before integration decisions are made, translating commercial needs into data specs and data constraints back into product expectations. You will: - Lead structured evaluation of new data sources from scratch — assessing schema, coverage, freshness, legal constraints, and fit against H1's product needs before any engineering work begins - Own field mapping from source to H1's bronze/silver/gold layers, producing data dictionaries, entity definitions, and structural guidance for downstream teams - Partner with engineering and Data Lake to define ingestion requirements, entity resolution rules, and refresh cadences for new sources - Gather requirements from client-facing teams and translate them into integration specifications; serve as the authoritative voice on what a new source can and cannot deliver before product commitments are made - Shepherd each source end-to-end: scoping → QA → entity matching → product launch, including product QA and communicating source capabilities and limitations to product and enablement partners - Work with the Insights team to develop new taxonomies and QA mechanisms for novel data types - Define acceptance criteria and lead QA validation including field-level fill rates, count comparisons, and cycle-over-cycle anomaly detection - Investigate and resolve data quality issues post-integration, coordinating with DART and engineering as needed - Hand off to the maintaining team with complete mapping documentation; you own onboarding, not ongoing maintenance - Produce and maintain documentation other people actually use — across scoping assessments, field mapping specs, and post-mortems ABOUT YOU You are a senior data professional who has personally owned the full lifecycle of a data integration — not just contributed to one. You are comfortable working across ambiguous, novel data structures and can ramp quickly on new source types each quarter. You operate with strong judgment about where integration risk lives, and you communicate clearly to both technical partners and client-facing stakeholders about what data can and cannot do. REQUIREMENTS - 8–12+ years in data-focused roles at healthcare data companies, pharma/biotech data vendors, health IT firms, or equivalent - Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of data integrations built from scratch — scoping, field mapping, QA, and handoff —

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Role We Need PadSplit is growing its analytics platform and needs a hands-on Sr. Data Engineer to work alongside our existing DE lead. This person will build and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines across Dagster (or Airflow), dbt, and Snowflake, with supporting work in Python, Airbyte, and AWS. The role combines building new pipelines and data models with providing real coverage on critical paths — especially the daily Postgres → Snowflake → dbt flow and third-party API loads — all shipped through reviewed pull requests rather than one-off scripts. The Person We Are Looking For We're looking for a practitioner who thinks natively in dimensions, facts, and slowly changing dimensions — someone who knows when to use a full refresh versus an incremental load and how that choice affects idempotency and backfills. This person writes clear, reviewable PRs and gives equally thoughtful reviews, with attention to scoped diffs, sensible tests, and failure modes. They're comfortable in complex Python data flows and have enough AWS literacy to reason about task roles, buckets, and cross-account access without needing to own all of platform engineering. Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day: PR-driven shipping: Opening and merging pull requests for new or updated Dagster jobs, assets, schedules, and sensors, plus dbt models, tests, and documentation. Infrastructure tweaks: Writing occasional Terraform for secrets, environment variables, or job sizing when a pipeline needs it. Pipeline implementation: Building and debugging Python pipelines covering REST/API syncs, large Postgres extracts, Parquet loads, and Snowflake COPY operations. Airbyte management: Configuring or troubleshooting Airbyte connections wherever managed sync is the right fit. Production monitoring: Watching production runs and investigating failures related to IAM, OOM, Spot instances, or bad watermarks. Backfills & catch-ups: Running backfills and incremental catch-ups with a clear story for what landed and why. Modeling partnership: Working with analytics and product on dim/fct/x_fct design, incremental strategies, and data quality. Code review & runbooks: Participating in code review, release prep, and writing short runbooks so others can operate your pipelines when you're out. Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful: Warehouse fundamentals: Solid grasp of relational databases and warehouse patterns — keys, grain, normalization vs. star schema, and how SCD behavior gets encoded. Orchestration experience: Practical, hands-on Dagster (or Airflow) experience — not just writing SQL inside a scheduler UI. dbt proficiency: Real experience building and maintaining models, tests, and documentation in dbt. Python at scale: Comfort reading and writing Python that moves data at scale across extract, transform, and load steps. AWS working knowledge: Practical familiarity with S3, IAM, and ECS/Fargate at a "debug my job" level. EL tool familiarity: Experience with Airbyte or similar extract-and-load tools. PR discipline: The discipline to write pull requests others can easily review, and to give equally rigorous reviews in return. Reliability mindset: A track record of keeping pipelines healthy and modeling consistent across full refresh and incremental paths, without becoming a single point of failure. The Interview Process: Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team. If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes. If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Principal Data Scientist for forty-five (45) minutes. If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one and a half (1.5) hours. jobs.title: Senior Data Product Analyst
jobs.description: Product · New York, NY (Remote-Friendly) About the Role YipitData is making one of its most ambitious Product bets: building an AI-powered product that transforms how clients interact with data. This initiative sits at the center of our product strategy and represents a fundamentally new way for customers to access and derive value from our data. As a Senior Data Product Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in making that vision a reality. You will own the path from raw alternative data to trusted, product ready intelligence—determining how complex datasets are structured, interpreted, and ultimately surfaced to customers. This role sits at the intersection of data, product, and AI. You will work with diverse alternative datasets and develop the methodologies that transform those signals into reliable business insights. You will also serve as a key authority on how the product uses data, helping define what conclusions are methodologically sound, what questions can be answered confidently, and where appropriate guardrails should exist. Success in this role requires both analytical rigor and a builder's mindset. You'll thrive in ambiguity, tackle problems without established playbooks, and help shape the future of one of YipitData's most strategic products. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of customers interact with our data and how this product scales over time. What You'll Do Data Source Ownership & Methodology Design Own the translation of raw alternative datasets into scalable, AIready data products. Design methodologies that answer high-value business questions, determining how disparate datasets should be combined, normalized, and interpreted. Partner closely with Data Engineering to shape source data pipelines into clean, well-structured datasets with clear definitions and documentation. Develop deep expertise in the strengths, limitations, biases, and coverage characteristics of key datasets and ensure those nuances are reflected in downstream outputs. AI Product Intelligence & Knowledge Systems Define how the product should use different datasets, including valid query patterns, edge cases, failure modes, and methodological guardrails. Own metric definitions, data lineage, and documentation to ensure the product consistently delivers accurate and explainable answers. Establish standards for how the product reasons across multiple datasets, preventing over-interpretation and ensuring conclusions remain statistically defensible. Serve as the final reviewer for methodology-related changes that impact product behavior. Product Development & Customer Problem Solving Translate customer questions into scalable methodologies, data models, and product capabilities. Expand the range of questions the product can answer by enabling new forms of segmentation, cohort analysis, behavioral measurement, and cross-dataset insights. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to identify new data sources, use cases, and capabilities that increase the commercial value of the AI product. Help shape the product roadmap by turning emerging customer needs and experimental insights into repeatable product functionality. Data Quality & Operational Excellence Coordinate testing and validation of staged data changes before they reach production. Own incident management processes for data quality issues, methodology changes, and upstream source disruptions. Build and maintain a library of quality checks tailored to the unique requirements of AI-powered customer experiences. Ensure the product consistently surfaces reliable, accurate, and internally consistent information across all supported use cases. You Are Likely to Succeed If You Have 3–6 years of experience in data product management, product analytics, analytics engineering, data science, market intelligence, alternative data, or a closely related field. jobs.title: FDE Data Engineer- Space (FedD141/FedD147)
jobs.description: EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE U.S. CITIZENSHIP. Role Description This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes: the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments. You'll help take UDS Data Capability from "deployable" to "running in production under classification." You will deploy, integrate, and operate our data stack in the mission hero's environment alongside senior engineers, then carry what you learn back into the product so the next engagement is easier. The scope of this work varies by engagement. Some programs require standing up a governed data platform to centralize sensor or operational data from known sources, where the problem is well-defined and the priority is building and shipping. Others involve consolidating data across hundreds of interconnected government systems of record with overlapping schemas, deeply interdependent data flows, and significant architectural complexity. You should be comfortable building independently against defined problems and growing into more ambiguous, complex engagements over time. Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement calls for it: initial standup, integration work, incident response, training and knowledge transfer. The rest of the time, you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero. The role is defined by the relationship with the mission hero, not by where you sit. You are a data engineer who can build across the breadth of a data platform (storage, ingestion, streaming, governance, and access) and deliver working solutions in constrained, mission-critical environments. Responsibilities Deploy and configure UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment. Stand up the UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required. Build and support integrations with existing mission systems. Connect UDS Data Capability to legacy databases, flat-file drops, SOAP/REST endpoints, message buses, existing object storage, and identity providers (Keycloak, mission-side SSO). Prior experience integrating with these types of systems is more relevant than experience building on them. Contribute to mapping complex data landscapes. Some engagements involve hundreds of interconnected systems of record with overlapping schemas and deeply interdependent data flows. You'll help trace how data moves across systems and identify dependencies alongside senior engineers and government stakeholders. Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries, including ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions. Implement data provenance, lineage, and governance practices. Track where data came from, how it transformed, and who can access it. Operate what you deploy. Day-2 ownership includes capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Hand off to the mission hero's ops team once it's stable. Generate accreditation artifacts, including STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings. You produce the evidence the mission hero's ISSM/ISSO needs to run this in IL4/IL5. Contribute field feedback back to product and engineering. File issues, write postmortems, and surface what's working and what's breaking in the mission environment. Support training and knowledge transfer. Contribute to runbooks, architecture docs, and working sessions that leave the mission hero's team self-sufficient. Preferred Locations: Colorado Springs, CO or Florida Spac

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . YOUR ROLE You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. jobs.title: Contract Sr Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
jobs.description: The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets. Engineering Deliverables Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership. Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience. Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams. Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends. Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate Scope The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership. Required Skills Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. Domain Knowledge: Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience. Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights. Independent problem solving: Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources. Hiring Ranges: Remote Germany $62,100—$82,800 USD

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Key Responsibilities Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness. Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required. Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. Qualification path Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets Preferred Qualifications Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
